Contributors are told to run go test ./..., make test, and make all.
make all runs fmt and test; test depends on install_deps, which runs go get -v ./....
CI runs license headers, golangci-lint, and richgo tests across Unix/Windows Go versions.

No product runtime databases, queues, object stores, auth, email, payment, SMS, webhook, analytics, or model-provider dependencies were detected.

assessment_matrix.rationale: Go test, Makefile, CONTRIBUTING, and CI provide clear build/test/review flows; no SDD-like planning flow detected.
gofmt, go test, and golangci-lint are available, but no git-hook/pre-commit wiring was detected and Makefile test mutates dependency state.
Local commands map to CI concepts, but CI uses richgo, OS/Go matrix, addlicense, and golangci action while local parity is split.
Makefile and docs are useful but diffuse; no canonical .harness contract existed before setup.
Broad hermetic tests use public seams and in-memory buffers to prove real library behavior.
No product runtime infrastructure or secret-gated services block local proof.
Strong API seams and colocated tests, tempered by large central core files.
Exit codes and verbose test output are deterministic, but structured artifacts are absent before harness setup.
